doc: Seahorse is a graphical interface for managing and using encryption keys, passwords and certificates. Currently it supports PGP keys (using GPG/GPGME) and SSH keys. Its goal is to provide an easy to use Key Management Tool, along with an easy to use interface for encryption operations.

-?, --help
Prints a short help text and exits.
--help-all
Show all help options
--help-gtk
Show all GTK options

-v, --version
Version of this application
--display=DISPLAY
X display to use
If you find a bug, please report it at https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/seahorse/issues/new.
